changes.content: RegistrationForm — local field validation, submit handler. RegistrationStatusView — polls getRegistrationStatus; no Work Unit builds it (HLD-F02). ApiClient — gateway-only, carries the session correlation id on every call.

400 -> render the field-level problem detail against the FBO field and preserve the entered value. 422 -> render the attestation requirement; the client guard is re-shown but is not treated as the control. Network failure on submit -> the form is not cleared and the submission is not retried automatically; a silent retry could create a second registration the producer never intended.

RegistrationStatusView polls at a fixed interval with no countdown and no progress indication. The view cannot distinguish a slow lookup from a timed-out one and must not imply it can (S-F1.1-b-AC3, wireframes WF-02).
